m_questTitle: Do I Look Fat In This?

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Greetings, young Wizard. You wish to adopt the majestic form of an Elephant? For Vir Goodheart, that innocent soul, anything.
You may owe me a favor tomorrow, or tomorrow, or tomorrow, eh?
Drink from my cauldron and you will feel the power of the pachyderm course through your veins.
Beautiful! Go, Wizard, and enter the jaws of the dread Black Palace. Try not to get yourself killed!
What is the password? "Nants ingonyama bagithi baba?" Uh, yeah, that sounds right
<ITALICS>The transformation spell works! You are able to walk through the powerful ward without hesitation or harm. </ITALICS>
It will still take us many days to unravel the chaos spread by the agents of shadow, but at least we can see a new dawn.
The Umbra Queen's servant said they were taking my son to the Drum Jungle? They can have but one purpose...
...to visit the Elephant Graveyard! The Golden Swords are there!
Like the Lions and Zebras, the Elephants were given a sacred relic by the Council of Light to hold back the darkness.
If the Umbra Queen gets them, who knows what havoc she might wreak?
With the password, you can get by the guards. But the mystical ward on the gate will only allow an Elephant through.
Zeddgan Spellfeather is a shaman in the Sook. He can make you a transformation potion, if you ask nicely.
Once Zeddgan has turned you into an Elephant, enter the Black Palace, find Councilor Rasik, and take him to the Queen!
Get Zeddgan Spellfeather to change you into an Elephant, enter the Black Palace, find Councilor Rasik, and tell Queen Aryanah.
